commodity.label: Milk products (not cheese)
commodity.definition: Milk and cream, concentrated and powdered milk, yoghurt, buttermilk, whey and butter (HS 0401–0405). Excludes cheese, which is a separate basket. Net mass adds products as recorded (liquid milk, powders, butter), not converted to a milk equivalent.
